name: protected-files-check
description: Detects modifications to protected files that require explicit human review before merge (AGENTS.md, security configs, production migrations, settings.gradle.kts)

validationAction.command: echo 'PROTECTED FILE MODIFIED: Human review required before merge'
validationAction.description: Flag that a protected file has been modified. These files require explicit human approval per project governance rules.
validationAction.failureMessage: A protected file was modified. This change requires explicit approval from a human maintainer before merge. See AGENTS.md section 'Arquivos Protegidos' for the full list.
